capabilities: Fetch prayer times from the Aladhan API for a configured or auto-detected city
Select which prayers (e.g., Fajr, Dhuhr) to display
Write prayer times to a note using custom templates with date and time placeholders
Choose 12-hour or 24-hour time formats and custom date formats
Trigger updates on vault startup, note opening, or both
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull daily prayer times for a location into the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects to the Aladhan API to retrieve prayer times.

summary: Fetches daily Islamic prayer times from the Aladhan API for a chosen city and writes them to a note with configurable formats and templates.
